messages.content: Extract all explicitly stated payment relationships. Return one row per payer/payee/payment, including coordinated recipients and reverse-direction events. Use exact short source substrings for role fields and the full exact supporting sentence for event_evidence. Null means unstated. Distinguish the service period from the time of payment; do not infer a payment year. Keep remuneration_kind (a stated noun such as wages) separate from payment_medium (a stated physical material such as cash or hay). The verbs paid and the nouns payment or wages do not themselves identify a physical payment medium. A dollar amount alone does not establish cash. Use null for an unstated material, never a generic category or invented span. No final legal answer, code, classification or arithmetic. Return only the schema object.

{"facts": "Alice has paid wages of $6771 to Bob, $6954 to Charlie, and $6872 to Dan for agricultural labor done from Feb 1st, 2017 to Sep 2nd, 2017. Bob has paid wages of $4520 to Alice for work done from Apr 1st, 2017 to Sep 2nd, 2018."}

payment_medium.description: Exact stated physical payment material, for example cash or hay; null if the physical material is unstated. Payment and wages name the transaction/kind, not its material. A dollar amount alone does not identify cash. Never invent a source span.

remuneration_kind.description: Exact stated remuneration noun, for example wages. This is separate from the physical material used to pay.
